name: Tractor Supply Distribution Center Frankfort NY

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled entrance at the NW corner: a gatehouse/booth with a canopy and lane-line pinch point sits across the truck lane where the access loop road meets the yard (z19/z20 imagery, ~43.0367,-75.0899). Full chain-link perimeter fence confirmed in Street View along the entire road frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small white-roofed booth (~1-2 stall footprint) beside the gate lane with an adjacent canopy structure; a vehicle is parked at it. Classic staffed gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck drive between the gate and the dock aprons on the NE side provides interior queue room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal apron/drive from the NW gate down the NE face holds well over 3 trucks; deep approach.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single gate complex at the NW corner serves both directions; no separate out-gate observed.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 1-2 inbound lanes through the gate from overhead imagery; exact count low-confidence.
fieldNotes.exitLanes: Estimated 1 outbound; low-confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved gate apron and multi-lane throat at the NW entrance with unused width to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors on BOTH long faces (NE and SW) at a tight regular rhythm along a ~350m building; combined count well into the 50+ band (est. ~70).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive marked trailer-drop stalls: NE center-island row + far row near the road, plus a full SW-face drop row; combined 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks on opposite (NE and SW) building faces suggests separate ship/receive operations; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / rural setting: bordered by woods and an open farm field to the W and S, just off the NY-5S expressway outside Frankfort.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main DC plus a separate office/ancillary building with its own parking near the NE access road.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows on both NE and SW sides, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Honest overhead estimate (~95) across both drop yards and dock positions in the captured imagery.

citations.claim: Herkimer County Chamber of Commerce lists the Tractor Supply Company Distribution Center at 1938 Country Mile, Frankfort NY as an operating member facility (Business Before Hours event).
Active Tractor Supply DC Team Member postings at the Frankfort, NY distribution center as of 2026.

verification.rationale: TSC Northeast DC (opened ~2019); current DC careers at exact address plus county chamber econ-dev listing; no closure/WARN.
